name: AetherGrok Release Changelog
description: Central single source of truth for all AetherGrok releases, commit ranges, and download artifacts.

releases.title: AetherGrok 1.1.11 - Human-Friendly Plan Update Summaries & Accurate Cumulative Task Tracking
highlights: Replace confusing jumping task numbers (e.g. 0/4, 0/8, 10/10) with informative action-based labels in chat feed tool cards (e.g. 'Completed Step 1 → Started Step 2')
Enrich partial diffs (merge: true) with full task names from session plan state
Display accurate cumulative progress metrics (e.g. '3/10 completed') based on total session plan rather than isolated partial updates
Add formatPlanUpdateSummary and resolveTodoContent utility functions with comprehensive Vitest coverage

releases.title: AetherGrok 1.1.10 - Fix Blank Screen on App Launch & Restore Prompt Attachment Sync
highlights: Fix critical ReferenceError: handleManualRetry is not defined in App.svelte that caused the desktop app to render a blank window on startup
Add handleManualRetry callback for manual task continuation after exhausted token truncation auto-retries
Fix AttachedFile and VisionImage filePath / dataUrl / timestamp typing consistency in Composer.svelte
Exclude internal subagent sessions from workspace session discovery list
Restore full file and image attachment synchronization on prompt edit and turn rollback

releases.title: AetherGrok 1.1.5 - Fix Remote Session Restore 404 on Fresh Sessions
highlights: Prevent Grok CLI 'session not found locally, restoring conversation from remote... 404 Not Found' error by ensuring --resume is only passed when an initialized local session exists
Add SessionFolderExists validation that verifies session folder and chat records on disk across workspace session stores before selecting --resume vs --session-id
Safely initialize fresh sessions with explicit --session-id without triggering remote cloud registry lookups

releases.title: AetherGrok 1.1.4 - Large Document Attachments & Windows CLI Command Length Fix
highlights: Resolve 'The filename or extension is too long' Windows CreateProcess limit (32,767 chars) by offloading large prompts and attached files to temporary UTF-8 files via --prompt-file
Enable seamless attachment of large documents (Markdown, code, logs) without command line buffer exhaustion
Maintain temporary prompt file hygiene with automatic post-run cleanup

releases.title: AetherGrok 1.1.3 - Session Isolation & In-Flight Prompt Persistence
highlights: Eliminate cross-session contamination in the same workspace by replacing newest-folder fallback with strict UUID matching in session scanner
Generate RFC4122 v4 UUIDs on new session creation and pass explicit --session-id to Grok CLI runner
Preserve in-flight prompts and active streaming status when switching tabs or sessions by guarding disk reloads during active working state
Harden session isolation unit test suite validating zero signal leakage between independent sessions

releases.title: AetherGrok 1.1.2 - CLI Startup Watchdog, Deadlock Defense & Session Recovery
highlights: 45-second startup watchdog in Grok runner to detect and terminate frozen CLI processes when resuming massive or corrupted session histories
Buffered stderr capture providing clear error diagnostics upon CLI startup or execution failures
Frontend session store sanitization resetting stale loading states and hung spinners on application startup
Robust error rendering in chat conversation ensuring failed turns never lock the composer

releases.title: AetherGrok 1.1.1 - Windows Session Resume, Updater Detached Elevation & Light Mode Polish
highlights: Fix Windows multi-prompt session fragmentation by ensuring reliable path resolution and --resume arguments in Grok runner
Save auto-update downloads directly to standard user Downloads folder across platforms
Implement detached elevation batch script for Windows installer to eliminate file locks and ensure automatic restart
Reset Active Plan Tracker on each new prompt submission for a clean execution state
Refine light mode contrast for Plan Mode pills and Plan Objective cards

releases.title: AetherGrok 1.0.8 - Real-Time Plan Tracker, Input Shielding & ACP Stream Parser
highlights: Real-time interactive Floating Plan Tracker HUD and dedicated Plan Panel with reactive task lifecycle states
Context-aware Input Shield protecting terminal and modal inputs from hotkey collision and accidental submissions
High-performance ACP NDJSON stream parser enhancements with resilient token chunking and metadata reconciliation
Enhanced diff rendering cards with additions/deletions counters and unified diff formatting

Penyiapan pipeline GitHub Actions yang membuild installer desktop untuk macOS (.dmg) dan Windows (.exe NSIS) secara otomatis.
Penambahan flag macOS minimum deployment untuk merapikan warning compiler AVFoundation dan pemisahan build tags platform.
